structure.unit: Taxes Administered by the Department of Taxation
Interstate Compromise and Arbitration of Death Taxes

law.catch_line: Nothing in article to prevent compromise
law.text: Nothing contained in this article shall prevent at any time a written compromise, if otherwise lawful, by all parties to the agreement made pursuant to § 58.1-923 fixing the amounts to be accepted by this and any other state involved, in full satisfaction of death taxes.
